title: React Native Features
seo: Add features to your React Native app
meta: New screens, fixes and features added to your existing React Native app, tested on iOS and Android. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: React Native feature development for your live app
overview: Send us your app repository and a list of what you want changed. We read the code first, then agree each feature in writing. We build it inside your project using your existing patterns, test it on iOS and Android and open a pull request you can review. Small fixes, new screens and full flows are all fine, as long as the list fits the package you pick.

pkgs.blurb: One small feature or a few fixes, tested on both platforms.
list: One feature or up to 3 small fixes

pkgs.blurb: A new flow with its own screens, built into your app.
list: Up to 3 features or 1 full flow

pkgs.blurb: A larger set of features with tests and a release build.
list: Up to 6 features or 2 full flows

faq: My app was built by someone else. Can you work on it?

Yes, most of our work is in existing apps. Send the repository and we review the structure first. We follow your folder layout and libraries, and tell you before we start if something looks risky to change.
Do you need my Apple and Google accounts?
Not for feature work. We build and test locally and send you a test build. If you want us to upload a release, add us as a team member in your account. We never ask for your passwords.
What if a feature needs a paid service?
We tell you before building. Services such as maps, SMS or payments are billed by the provider directly to you. Our price covers the code that connects your app to them.
No, new screens follow your current look. If you want a fresh interface across the app, the redesign service is a better fit and we can quote it next to the feature work.
